scenarios.name: The first mode puts a +1/+1 counter on Gala Greeters when another creature enters
scenarios.ruling: Another creature entering under your control triggers the ability; with the first mode chosen the only thing that happens is one +1/+1 counter on Gala Greeters, so it is a 2/2, no Treasure is made and no life is gained.

scenarios.name: The second mode creates a tapped Treasure token when another creature enters
scenarios.ruling: With the second mode chosen the trigger creates a Treasure token and that token enters tapped; Gala Greeters gets no counter and no life is gained.

scenarios.name: The third mode gains you 2 life when another creature enters
scenarios.ruling: With the third mode chosen the trigger only gains its controller 2 life: no counter goes on Gala Greeters and no Treasure token is created.

scenarios.name: A mode already chosen this turn cannot be chosen again for the second trigger
scenarios.ruling: The ability says "choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn", so once the first trigger has taken the +1/+1 counter mode the second creature to enter that turn must use one of the two remaining modes; Gala Greeters therefore ends the turn with exactly one counter, not two.
